# Web Audits: Comprehensive LLM Knowledge Base

> Web Audits (webaudits.pro) is an independent web performance, technical SEO, Core Web Vitals, and website forensics publication and software laboratory. We test websites with instrumented browser telemetry and publish empirical benchmarks, comparative software reviews, and free diagnostic tools.

## Architectural Guidelines and Testing Thresholds

### Core Web Vitals Reference Benchmarks
- Largest Contentful Paint (LCP): Good <= 2.5s, Needs Improvement 2.5s - 4.0s, Poor > 4.0s.
- Interaction to Next Paint (INP): Good <= 200ms, Needs Improvement 200ms - 500ms, Poor > 500ms.
- Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS): Good <= 0.1, Needs Improvement 0.1 - 0.25, Poor > 0.25.
- Time to First Byte (TTFB): Good <= 800ms, Reference target <= 300ms on cached edge HTML.

### DOM Tree Complexity Benchmarks
- Maximum Recommended DOM Nodes: Under 1,400 elements (Google Lighthouse standard).
- Observed Latency Spike Point: 1,800+ DOM nodes correlate with a 3.4x spike in browser style recalculation time during continuous scroll gestures.
- Container Nesting Depth: Maximum depth exceeding 18 levels creates measurable layout thrashing on low-end and mid-range mobile chips.

- Purpose: Chrome extension for in-browser client-side website forensics and agency client acquisition.

### LCP Element Checker
- URL: https://www.webaudits.pro/tools/lcp-checker
- Purpose: In-browser inspector identifying the Largest Contentful Paint DOM node and flagging fetchpriority and lazy-loading anti-patterns.

## Signature Benchmark Summaries

### 1. Elementor Pro vs GenerateBlocks (Native Gutenberg)
- Site: Identical visual layouts deployed on Cloudways DigitalOcean 2GB PHP 8.2 environments.
- Total DOM Nodes: Elementor (1,220 nodes) vs GenerateBlocks (342 nodes) -> 72% reduction in layout tree complexity.
- Total Wire Requests: Elementor (418 KB across 18 requests) vs GenerateBlocks (44 KB across 2 requests) -> 89% decrease in frontend footprint.
- Mobile LCP: Elementor (3.42s - Failed CWV) vs GenerateBlocks (1.34s - Passed CWV).

### 2. Mobile LCP Root Cause Diagnostics
- Primary Bottleneck: In 84% of failing audited URLs, delays stemmed from unprioritized hero images or background banners.
- Lazy Loading Pitfall: 41% of mobile sites erroneously applied loading=lazy to the hero image, delaying rendering by 600ms to 1.2s.
- Recommended Fix: Apply fetchpriority=high and loading=eager to viewport hero media, paired with responsive srcset under 75KB mobile budgets.
